Finance Desk

In a terminal workdir, fix seeded bugs in small repos or solve procedural finance problems and write answer.json, then call evaluate.

How it is scored
Mixed
Signal

How to run it

1. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download bpHigh/finance-desk --repo-type dataset --local-dir finance-desk

Framework documentation: OpenEnv. Needs: Docker image ghcr.io/bp-high/finance-desk:v3 (linux/amd64).

Evidence

Every task id was calibrated on a live Qwen3.8-27B loop and only mixed-outcome ids were submitted; reference solutions pass.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
